evidence: The Dewan Negara archive prints D.R.11/2013 under the title of D.R.8/2013, Pencegahan Jenayah (Pindaan dan Pemerluasan) 2013, which it does not list otherwise, and dates the first reading 1 January 1970. The Dewan Rakyat prints D.R.11/2013 as Kesalahan Keselamatan (Langkah-Langkah Khas) (Pindaan) 2013. Which bill the record describes cannot be told, so it is left off both.
